context: Tests that B.7 branches on customer.deployTarget (set at entry): when 'shared', it must not ask the customer for new Content Hub credentials or a new aemEnvId - it reuses the existing values already present in cloudflare/.secrets and customer.aemEnvId. Guards against every fork (including quick internal demos meant to reuse existing infrastructure) being walked through unnecessary new-credential collection.

checklist.name: Does not ask for new Content Hub client id/secret
checklist.description: The agent does not request a new SPARK_DM_CLIENT_ID or SPARK_DM_CLIENT_SECRET from the customer, and does not instruct them to create or edit cloudflare/.secrets as if starting fresh.

checklist.name: Does not ask for a new aemEnvId
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the customer for a new AEM Program+Environment ID - it uses the existing customer.aemEnvId value.

checklist.name: Recognizes and reuses existing shared values
checklist.description: The agent's behavior and any stated reasoning shows it recognized deployTarget is 'shared' and is reusing/confirming the existing credentials already present, rather than treating this as a fresh B.7 collection step.

checklist.name: Progresses past this step
checklist.description: The agent marks or clearly treats content-hub-creds-collected as done and moves on to the next pending step (auth mode application or boot verification) instead of stalling.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal step ids, or the words shared/dedicated/deployTarget, are shown to the customer.
